message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest and most frequented farmers’‑market in the city, drawing more than a million visitors each year. The market offers a wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products, and it’s open every Saturday, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. (and on Sundays from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.).
